title: Kentucky appeals court overturns ruling favouring husband in $703,000 farm dispute
summary_full: Mary and Fred Holden's property settlement agreed to equal ownership of their Kentucky farm. Disagreements arose regarding when the farm should be listed for sale after two years. After their son moved out, Mary requested the farm be sold or purchased by Fred. The appeals court found the agreement's wording ambiguous, requiring a fresh evaluation in family court.
